body.name: Published-setup dynamic RIPW estimator
body.construction:
For \(i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}\), let \(\pi_i(w)\) be the known generalized propensity and extend \(\Pi_w\) by zero off \(\mathcal S\).  Define \(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{ex},n}\) as the coefficient component of any minimizer
\[
 (\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{ex},n},\widehat\alpha,\widehat\lambda)
 \in\mathop{\arg\min}_{\substack{\beta\in\mathbb R^d,\,\alpha\in\mathbb R^n,\,\lambda\in\mathbb R^T\\
                    \sum_{i=1}^n\alpha_i=0,\ \sum_{t=1}^T\lambda_t=0}}
 \sum_{i=1}^n\frac{\Pi_{W_i}}{\pi_i(W_i)}
 \left\|Y_i-\alpha_i\mathbf 1_T-\lambda-D_{W_i}\beta\right\|_2^2.
\]
